integrity.mathematical_claim: Complete exact ordered two-projector fiber law, support count, and energy identity for every binary field size.
integrity.reproducibility: The embedded standalone Python checker independently enumerates the fields of orders 4,16,64,256 and matches all trace-zero target counts. Finite tests are distinct from the symbolic proof.

scientific_limitations: Dimension-two self-adjoint idempotents over quadratic extensions of characteristic-two finite fields only; two unweighted ordered summands; no assertion about higher dimensions, odd characteristic, or higher-fold convolutions. The source-priority comparison is bounded, and independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Complete two-projector convolution in characteristic-two Hermitian matrix planes
